BrochureContent.Content: DNG Martin O'Connor Estate Agents are delighted to offer for sale this exceptional home in the heart of the Connemara Gaeltacht at Lettermullen, Co. Galway. Presented in immaculate condition, this beautifully maintained property, together with the surrounding garden and a separate holding of land, extends to a total stated area of 5.65 acres enjoys tranquil surroundings with distant sea views.The property sits on a large maintained lawn with a private driveway with kerbing while a large garage sits to the rear of the house giving excellent storage and private parking.This is a stylish three-bedroom home which offers bright and spacious accommodation throughout. Flooded with natural light, each room enjoys a wonderful sense of space and comfort, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. This is a home ready for immediate occupation with nothing left to do but move in and enjoy.You enter the home through a wide entrance hall, where an open-plan living, dining and kitchen area lies to the left, offering an exceptionally bright and spacious living space. A rear door off the utility room leads to the back garden. The bedroom accommodation is thoughtfully laid out to provide both comfort and privacy, comprising three generously proportioned double bedrooms with quality wood flooring. The fully tiled family bathroom is fitted with a bath, separate shower, WC and wash hand basin, while the spacious central hallway provides an excellent flow throughout the home.Situated in a peaceful and scenic location, making it an ideal choice for a family home, holiday retreat, or investment property. The property is located 5.8 km drive to Lettermore village, and 17.7 km from Carraroe village, a thriving Gaeltacht community. The property is ideally located close to Connemara Isles Golf Club. The surrounding area of Lettermore is characterised by its breathtaking landscape of rugged coastline, unspoilt sandy beaches, and crystal-clear waters. Set within the heart of the Gaeltacht where the Irish language thrives.A gem like this property rarely becomes available and early viewing is highly advised.For more information or to book your viewing call us on (091) 866708 or email us on infomartinoconnor@dng.ie.

Entrance Hall - 
The accommodations opens into a wide entrance hall with tiled flooring.

Kitchen Dining Room - 
The kitchen/dining/living area is an open-plan room, extremely spacious and light with windows overlooking the front and rear lawn. The room feature a stove set in a stone fire surround.

Utility Room - 
The utility room is off the kitchen and offers ample storage including wall units for additional storage. Hot-press offering excellent storage.

Bedroom 1 - 
A bright and spacious double bedroom featuring warm wooden flooring. Designed with comfort in mind, this inviting space offers plenty of room to relax while maintaining a clean, uncluttered feel.

Bedroom 2 - 
Bedroom 2 is a well-proportioned double bedroom combines style and practicality, with attractive wooden flooring and ample storage solutions. The spacious layout creates a comfortable and versatile retreat, ideal for modern living.

Bedroom 3 - 
Bedroom 3 is also a generous sized double bedroom offering elegant wooden flooring and excellent storage space. Light-filled and spacious, this room provides the perfect balance of functionality and comfort.

Bathroom - 
A bright, fully tiled bathroom finished to a high standard, featuring a full-size bath with a seperate shower, WC, and wash hand basin. The light-filled space offers a clean, modern finish with both style and practicality.

Hotpress - 
The hotpress offers additional storage alongside the water tank.

• Lovely coastal home
  • c. 5.65 acres of land.
  • Three spacious bedrooms.
  • Bright and airy open-plan living/dining/kitchen area.
  • Large well maintained garden.
  • Large detached garage to the rear.
  • Move-in ready, finished to an exceptional standard.
  • Good storage.
  • Set in the Gaeltacht area where the Irish language thrives.
